about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Gesture: Flying Broomstick

A gesture where you can show off moving around on a magical broom.

Enjoy communicating and taking pictures with friends while using special gestures!

*You can use gestures from the Gestures option in either the Communication or Photo Mode menus.
*This product is also available as part of a set.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
